display_name: The Holy Infants, with Eleutherius and Leonides

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Αυγούστου, «Άγιοι Ελευθέριος, Λεωνίδης και τα Άγια Νήπια», with the rank word «Άγια» left off. The page prints no number for them and no name of any one of them.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιοι Ελευθέριος, Λεωνίδης και τα Άγια Νήπια»

attestations.note: The third party of the one listing line, and the only one the page does not name: it prints no number for the infants and no name of any one of them, so by the rule that a company naming nobody is one entry they are one folder here and not several. The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on it. The distich the page prints speaks of two contenders only, «Ἀμφοῖν ἀθλητῶν», so the service text the page gives does not cover the infants; and the page prints no hymn of any kind. No year and no country.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
